425:t_3:15.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Then I'll enter the release code.」

425:t_3:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Confidentiality level 3 cleared. I will disclose information about $$プロジェクト・ジェミニ$$.」

425:t_3:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$プロジェクト・ジェミニ$$...」

425:t_3:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's clearly connected to the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

425:t_3:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The purpose of $$プロジェクト・ジェミニ$$ is to seize the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$.」

425:t_3:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When the project began, we had confirmed that the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$ was installed in $$ジェミニア#robot$$ on Planet $$ジェミナイ$$.」

425:t_3:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ジェニオン$$ was deliberately designed to resemble $$ジェミニア#robot$$ so that it could seize its $$スフィア$$.」

425:t_3:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「Why go to the trouble of making $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ transform from $$ジェニオン$$?」

425:t_3:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are two reasons. First, to avoid putting $$ジェミニス$$ on guard...」

425:t_3:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Second, its pseudo-$$スフィア$$ lacked the output to fully realize $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s capabilities, which were designed for a $$スフィア$$'s power.」

425:t_3:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Incidentally, 'GAI' means 'corpse,' signifying that it lacks a soul... in other words, a $$スフィア$$.」

425:t_3:26.en:
$$カレン$$
「I didn't ask for your sickening trivia.」

425:t_3:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Next, $$ＤＥＭ$$ selected a person who met the activation conditions for the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$.」

425:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As the woman in Miss $$スズネ$$'s form said then, Miss $$スズネ$$ was originally intended to be $$ジェニオン$$'s pilot.」

425:t_3:32.en:
$n
「What was that black lump I touched at $$陣代高校$$?」

425:t_3:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That was $$ジェニオン$$'s operating manual and pilot registration system.」

425:t_3:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I had intended to have Miss $$スズネ$$ touch it and recruit her as its pilot.」

425:t_3:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I would have kept patiently persuading her... If that failed, threats... If those failed, mind control...」

425:t_3:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「So the story you told us when we first met, about coming to this world by chance, was all a lie.」

425:t_3:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is correct. Though I consider it a necessary expedient to carry out my duties.」

425:t_3:41.en:
$$キラ$$
「Wait, $$シン$$. Let's hear everything before we blame $$ＡＧ$$.」

425:t_3:42.en:
$$葵$$
「But wait... Why was Miss $$スズネ$$ chosen as the pilot?」

425:t_3:43.en:
$$くらら$$
「Are you saying Miss $$スズネ$$ had exceptionally strong opposing emotions inside her?」

425:t_3:45.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「Because Miss $$スズネ$$ had dissociative identity disorder... What people call a split personality.」

425:t_3:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Correct. Just as I would expect of a psychological counselor, $$ルゥ$$.」

425:t_3:48.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「I noticed what seemed to be signs of it during several counseling sessions.」

425:t_3:49.en:
$$カナリア$$
「My assessment was the same. ...Though I never imagined anyone was using it to activate a $$スフィア$$.」

425:t_3:50.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then when Miss $$スズネ$$'s tone sometimes changed, or she became strangely rough...」

425:t_3:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And now, apparently under the influence of $$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア・アクト$$, that other personality seems to have taken over the primary one.」

425:t_3:53.en:
$$タケル$$
「The one calling herself $$アムブリエル$$ is Miss $$スズネ$$'s hidden personality...」

425:t_3:54.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. Her outward and hidden personalities... Their coexistence creates opposing emotions.」

425:t_3:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As you know, the hidden personality is the exact opposite of the gentle, gracious Miss $$スズネ$$.」

425:t_3:56.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$ took notice of that and chose her as the pilot.」

425:t_3:57.en:
$n
「But I touched the manual meant for Miss $$スズネ$$ before she did.」

425:t_3:58.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a result, $$ジェニオン$$ was optimized for your personality and physical characteristics, $n.」

425:t_3:59.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Unfortunately, I was unable to cancel the pilot registration.」

425:t_3:60.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Fortunately, however, I also found opposing emotions within you, $n.」

425:t_3:61.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you made $n into a test pilot.」

425:t_3:63.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As insurance, I talked Miss $$スズネ$$ into becoming the copilot and used both of your opposing emotions to operate the pseudo-$$スフィア$$.」

425:t_3:64.en:
$$キリコ$$
「What do you think people are?」

425:t_3:65.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$n and Miss $$スズネ$$ aren't your tools!!」

425:t_3:66.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You may say whatever you like. This is my mission as an agent robot.」

425:t_3:68.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you understand!? Because of you, $n and Miss $$スズネ$$...!」

425:t_3:71.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Aren't you angry!? $$ＡＧ$$ was using you, $n!」

425:t_3:72.en:
$n
「I was using $$ＡＧ$$ too, trying to pursue the $$テンシ$$ with $$ジェニオン$$'s power... So we're even.」

425:t_3:73.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... quite like that detached side of you, $n.」

425:t_3:76.en:
$n
「I don't care about myself. But I won't forgive you for exploiting Miss $$スズネ$$'s kindness and dragging her into battle.」

425:t_3:77.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then what do you want me to do?」

425:t_3:78.en:
$n
「...Who do you think is more suited to the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$... me or Miss $$スズネ$$?」

425:t_3:80.en:
$n
「No... You don't need to answer. I have no intention of handing $$ジェニオン$$ over to anyone.」

425:t_3:81.en:
$n
「And I have no intention of making Miss $$スズネ$$ fight, either.」

425:t_3:82.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「She's already $$アムブリエル$$, you know?」

425:t_3:83.en:
$n
「If she has opposing emotions, Miss $$スズネ$$'s personality must still be there.」

425:t_3:84.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you mention it, that's true...」

425:t_3:85.en:
$n
「Help me, $$ＡＧ$$. You don't intend to hand $$ジェニオン$$ over to $$サイデリアル$$ either, do you?」

425:t_3:87.en:
$n
「You want to protect $$ジェニオン$$, and I want to get Miss $$スズネ$$ back... So it's the same as before.」

425:t_3:89.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though, given how long I've been unable to contact it, $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$ has most likely been crushed by $$サイデリアル$$...」

425:t_3:90.en:
$$赤木$$
「Wait, $n! You're going to trust $$ＡＧ$$ even after all this!?」

425:t_3:91.en:
$$シャア$$
「This contract may be like selling your soul to the devil.」

425:t_3:92.en:
$n
「Even so. Ordinary methods won't be enough to get Miss $$スズネ$$ back from them.」

425:t_3:93.en:
$n
「It's the same as pursuing the $$テンシ$$...」

425:t_3:94.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So you've made up your mind...」
